body.x: Seongnam Industry Promotion Agency introduced aiding smaller-sized, venture enterprises by participating at ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ which is hosted at Samsung-dong Coex for 4 days from 17th of October(Tues) to 20th(Fri).

Seongnam Industry Promotion Agency was founded in 2001 to enhance businesses’ competitiveness and providing aids to improve management of smaller-sized, venture enterprises This agency's duties are project planning and investigative researching to promote new-industries, providing all-round support including management/technology/information/capital/establishment/human resources etc., running business center and other facilities, pioneering overseas market and aiding businesses to export overseas, investing for corporate activities and establishing investment association etc.

The companies which participated as a part of joint-exhibition are Air Tech Co. Ltd. (air purifier), Migang Display Co. Ltd. (transparent mirror display), The-aio Co. Ltd. (eMMC storage), Wujunghightech Co. Ltd. (supersonic center flux filling equipment), Mobilio Co. Ltd. (vibration earthquake measuring equipment), Robowise Co. Ltd. (lego-compatible smart block), Lockin Company Co. Ltd. (integrated mobile security solution), Brosncompany Co. Ltd. (emotional monitor support), Metis (automatic emergency exit open and shutting equipment), Techwin System Co. Ltd. (electric system insulation monitoring equipment) etc.

A participant said, with the title of ‘Seongnam the leading city of 4th industrial revolution’, he will keep putting in his effort so people think of ‘Seongnam’ when 4th industrial revolution is mentioned.

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
